Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you looking for a side job or a part-time position?
 Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

For our client TVH in Waregem (located near the E17 motorway), we are looking for warehouse employees who would like to work on a flexible schedule.

We are looking for people to sort and unpack incoming parts and goods.

Your responsibilities will include:
 

 
• Sorting delivered goods. 
 
• Physically removing parts and goods from their packaging. 
 
• Checking quantities and stock counts. 
 
• Taking the initiative to keep the workplace clean and tidy. 
 
• Following all safety rules and procedures. 

 
• You can work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too! 
 
• You work accurately and are disciplined in following instructions. 
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 
 
• Physical work is not a problem for you (lifting and carrying items).

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.
